[SWS_CM_10532] Mapping of GetNewTriggers method
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00202, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008
⌈
When instructed to get new triggers, the DDS binding shall perform a
take()
on
the DataReader without specifying a
max_samples
limit, as described in [FO_PRS_
DDS_00208].
After calling
take()
, the binding implementation shall increase the internal trigger
count proportionally to the number of samples returned by take().
⌋
